messages:
maria_cs: Quick heads-up — SparrowTech asked for a temporary capacity bump and EU region enablement while they run a pilot next 2 weeks. Also need IP allowlist for their CDN. Can we action today?

sam_onboard: Thanks. Do we have the account id + current plan? I want to check quotas before asking infra to change limits.

maria_cs: Account: ST-9982, currently on Pro-500k tokens/mo. They want 2x rate limit (burst) for 14 days and EU region routing enabled. Customer flagged renewal in 6 weeks so this pilot is high priority.

alex_engineer: OK. For rate limit bump — do we mean per-min QPS or per-token throughput? They asked for "2x rate limit"; need exact config. Also need the list of IPs/domains to allowlist for callback webhooks.

maria_cs: They specifically said "2x upstream QPS for generation endpoints" and provided CDN egress IPs: `34.120.45.10`, `34.120.45.11`, and `34.120.45.12`. Webhook domain: `hooks.sparrow-tech.com`.

alex_engineer: Perfect. I'll open a change request. Proposed config snippet for ops:

```json
{
  "account_id": "ST-9982",
  "changes": {
    "rate_limit_multiplier": 2,
    "scope": "generation",
    "duration_days": 14,
    "region_routing": "eu-west-1",
    "allowlist_ips": ["34.120.45.10", "34.120.45.11", "34.120.45.12"],
    "allowlist_domains": ["hooks.sparrow-tech.com"]
  }
}
```

alex_engineer: Creating ticket CS-8543 and tagging infra. Will need deploy approval from ops-bot.

ops_bot: ticket CS-8543 created by alex_engineer. Attach runbook and impact assessment. Estimated change window: immediate (no downtime).

jessy_pm: Heads-up — renewal touchpoint scheduled: Tue 2026-04-07. Please capture pilot metrics (latency, token consumption, errors) so we can de-risk the renewal conversation.

maria_cs: Will ask customer to share expected traffic pattern + a short test prompt set. Sam, can you follow up on onboarding docs and ensure they have the eval suite?

sam_onboard: On it — I'll send the quickstart + eval harness today and ask them to schedule a 30m runbook review.

deploy-bot: Change CS-8543 approved. Applying rate_limit_multiplier=2 for account ST-9982, enabling region eu-west-1 routing, and adding allowlist entries. Change-id: change-20260320-009.

deploy-bot: Post-change checks: routing healthy, avg p95 latency unchanged, no auth errors. Bumped quota reflected in metrics.

maria_cs: Awesome — passing this back to the customer. Noting action items: capture pilot metrics, confirm webhook callbacks succeed, and follow up on renewal prep. Thanks everyone :tada:

sam_onboard: I'll log follow-ups in CS-8543 and ping again if anything flaps.

alex_engineer: Closing our side unless we see anomalies.

maria_cs: Closing thread on Slack — will update CS ticket with customer confirmation once I hear back.
